entities.name: UniProt P03647
observations: Exact 337-aa sequence match to reviewed Escherichia phage G4 minor spike protein; alignment identity and coverage are both 100%.
Annotated as a minor viral-shell spike component involved in host-range determination and phage DNA ejection into the host; localization is virion.
Reference annotation describes 12 spikes, each composed of five G proteins and one H protein; 60 copies each of F, G, and J and 12 copies of H per virion.
Pfam Microvir_H (PF04687.18) detected at residues 18–333; GO annotations include viral capsid (GO:0019028) and symbiont entry into host cell (GO:0046718).
Sequence-derived estimates: 337 aa, 35,706 Da, theoretical pI 6.86, instability index 26.0, GRAVY -0.599.
